author: U_ARTIFACTS_LEAD
text: Heads up all — effective Jan 15, the docker.io passthrough on our Artifactory proxy is being shut off for compliance (supply-chain SLSA L2). All Dockerfiles and CI jobs must pull base images from artifactory.corp/docker-remote/ instead. Pipelines still pointing at docker.io or public ECR will fail at build time. Also, FROM ubuntu:latest style unpinned tags are no longer allowed — pin by digest.

author: U_DEV_A
text: Does this apply to build-stage images in multi-stage Dockerfiles too, or just the final stage?

author: U_ARTIFACTS_LEAD
text: Every FROM line, both stages. The proxy shutoff doesn't care which stage you're in.

author: U_ARTIFACTS_LEAD
text: Planned maintenance: on Saturday Oct 3, 02:00–06:00 UTC the Artifactory proxy will be unavailable while we upgrade to 7.90. Artifact pulls and publishes will fail during this window. Please reschedule anything that runs in that slot.

author: U_GOVERNANCE
text: Reminder: the quarterly access review opens Monday. Team leads will get a DM from the governance bot with their list. Nothing to do until then.

author: U_OFFICE
text: The coffee machine on floor 3 is broken again ☕ engineer is coming Thursday.

author: U_SECURITY
text: Security notice: all Kubernetes workloads must set runAsNonRoot: true in their pod security context by Nov 30. We're turning on the admission controller in staging next week and prod on Dec 1 — anything without it will be rejected at admission.

author: U_HR
text: Please join me in welcoming Priya to the cloud platform team! She starts Monday and will be working on the landing zone rollout.

author: U_ARTIFACTS_LEAD
text: Update on the Artifactory passthrough change: after feedback from the payments and data teams we're moving the cutoff from Jan 15 to Feb 1 to give everyone another two weeks. Everything else about the change stands.

author: U_SRE
